questions.stemHtml: A 65 year old male presented with dysphagia in neck, Occasional regurgitation of old food and halitosis. Barium swallow revealed an outpouching from cervical esophagus. True statement about this condition is?

options.label: A
options.text: This is a type of acquired traction diverticulum.

options.label: B
options.text: This diverticulum comes from just below cricopharynx

options.label: C
options.text: Diverticulectomy and cricopharyngomyotomy is the best treatment

options.label: D
options.text: Best approach for surgery is through right neck.
